summary: A parent answers with infants, toddlers and a dog at their feet, willing to talk but busy and unsure of making it to the polls.
realLife: A volunteer on Election Day spoke with only one voter who had not yet voted, a woman holding children with a dog beside her.
sources: Mark Bernstein, The Human Cost of Canvassing, December 2018: https://www.MarkBernstein.org/Dec18/TheHumanCostofCanvassing.html
inGame: household record: young children, a pet; the resident's free time on the day

turns.turn: The talk is short and the vote is not settled
turns.pulledBy: household with small children, little time
turns.writesBack: a reminder of the polling place and a quick goodbye

turns.turn: The resident invites the canvasser to walk with them to the car
turns.writesBack: an offer of a lift is possible, the record notes it
